name: LaunchDarkly

theme.summary: Neon control room for feature flags and release governance.
principles: Keep the whole page on a dark midnight canvas.
Use violet-to-blue as an electronic signal.
Use 30px radius for user-facing controls and cards.
Use 60px radius for the top nav pill.
Use bright white product screenshots on dark for visual tension.

signalViolet.role: Hero headline accent, link underlines, outline actions, icon glows, gradient endpoint

voltageBlue.role: Primary CTA fill, tag outline accent, focused UI edges

plasmaCyan.role: Rare radial glow and atmospheric secondary endpoint

carbon.role: Nav pill, cards, code blocks, footer, button surfaces

graphite.role: Elevated panel outlines, card borders, secondary surfaces

steel.role: Input borders and inactive form fields

slate.role: Muted helper text and disabled labels

fog.role: Secondary text, subtle borders, placeholder copy

ash.role: Tertiary text, icon strokes, light dividers

paper.role: Primary text, heading fills, icon strokes, white product screenshots

mono.name: Sohne Mono / JetBrains Mono
mono.role: SDK names, code snippets, technical labels

floatingNavPill.content: logo, nav links with chevrons, sign-in, sandbox, Voltage Blue CTA

heroEmailCapture.layout: email field left, Voltage Blue action button right

segmentedTabControl.active: small Voltage Blue dot plus white text

featureChecklistItem.icon: checkmark in Voltage Blue or white
featureChecklistItem.layout: left-aligned vertical stack with 12px to 16px gaps

codeSnippetBlock.syntax: green strings, cyan keywords, pink literals

sdkResourceCard.content: small icon, white heading, white subtext

patterns: Hero with two-line headline, violet second line, subtext, and glowing email capture form
Floating nav pill fixed near the top center
Quiet logo strip with grayscale partner logos
Tabbed feature section with two-column text and product screenshot
Code integration section with code panel and explanatory copy
Product screenshot panels rendered as bright white cards on dark
layout.imagery: Bright product screenshots, code snippets, SDK examples, customer logos, and technical UI fragments

motion.usage: Subtle technical transitions and minimal glow pulse

do: Use 30px radius for buttons, tags, tabs, and cards.
Use 60px radius for the floating nav pill.
Use Signal Violet for the second line or key phrase in hero headlines.
Render embedded product screenshots as pure white panels on dark canvas.
Use the 179deg Voltage Blue to Signal Violet gradient for ambient glows.
Set body text at 16px to 18px for readability on dark.
Use mono font for SDK names, code, and technical identifiers.
dont: Do not use square corners or small 4px to 8px radii on user-facing components.
Do not use drop shadows for normal elevation; use glow instead.
Do not introduce additional accent colors.
Do not use white or gray for primary action buttons.
Do not center-align body copy or feature lists.
Do not use display headline line-height above 1.5.
Do not put dark product screenshots on the page.
